 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"to skip about playfully"** means to move around in a cheerful, lively, and playful manner. (खुशी से कूदना-फांदना)

 
 
• **Example: **The children were ***skipping about playfully*** in the garden.
 
 
 
• **"Gambol"** refers to running or jumping about playfully. (उछलना-कूदना)
 
 
• **Example: **The lambs were*** gamboling ***in the field.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct substitution for **"to skip about playfully**" is **'gambol'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Scramble** (हाथ-पांव मारना): To move hurriedly or clumsily from or into a particular place or position.

 
 
• **Example:** The children ***scrambled ***up the hill.
 
 
 
• **Amble** (धीरे-धीरे चलना): To walk or move at a slow, relaxed pace.
 
 
• **Example:** They ***ambled*** along the riverbank, enjoying the scenery.
 
 
 
• **Trundle** (धीरे-धीरे चलाना या घुमाना): To move or cause to move slowly and heavily, typically in a noisy or uneven way.
 
 
• **Example:** The old cart*** trundled*** down the street.
